items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Tiny Palm sent him to get me to play with him... So I worked there at the Dreamland with him and then tell the truth, we come on down there and played dances... tour.

ctx.x: I have a Christmas card from Earl Wynn. I've been wanting to hunt it up and show you. I'll show it to you tomorrow night if I can find it down. I'll fix your hunt here. I've been intending to do that. You going to have you wrote him or you going to write him? No, I'm going to write him. I'll tell him to tell him about me. I will. I sure will.
And tell us more about Tiny Paar.
